The '''Solaran Ministry of Education''' was the state ministry responsible for schools, literacy implementation, curriculum guidance, and education standards in [[Solara]].

== Literacy Reform ==

The ministry is source-attested in connection with implementation guidance after the 1898 adoption of the [[Solaran Alphabet|Sunline]] alphabet. It supported the education system created around the [[Education Reform Act of 1895]], when Solara moved toward mass literacy in a simplified writing system.

The ministry's role included teacher guidance, textbook adoption, school implementation, and coordination with language specialists.

== Education System ==

In the modern Solaran school system, public instruction prioritized the [[Solaran Language]] and Sunline literacy. [[Solra]], the Elder Tongue, remained important for advanced religious, archival, legal, or administrative tracks but was not the first writing system taught to most children.

This structure allowed Solara to preserve ceremonial tradition while still building a literate public sphere.

== Institutional Role ==

The ministry worked alongside the [[Solaran Language Office]], [[Solaran Academy of Linguistics]], and [[Solaran Parliament]] in language policy. Its work gave the state practical reach into classrooms and made national standards enforceable beyond the capital.

By the early 1990s, the ministry's nineteenth-century literacy legacy was part of Solara's broader administrative capacity.

== Canon Notes ==

The extracted source gives an 1899 implementation reference but not a full founding history for the ministry. This draft treats the ministry as source-attested for post-adoption Sunline implementation and leaves earlier institutional history open.
